results.snippet:

results.title: Arab nomads arrive in Chad after order to leave Niger
results.snippet:
# Hundreds of Arab nomads arrive in Chad after order to leave Niger

Around 800 Arab nomads from the Mahamid tribe, who have lived for decades in southeastern Niger, have arrived in Chad after being told to leave Niger, the Chadian government said Friday.

Niger's military regime accuses the Mahamid of supplying weapons and logistics to Boko Haram jihadists active in the region.
